remarks: Charming Summer Retreat in the Heart of Westport!    Blend timeless New England charm with today's modern comforts in this beautifully appointed 5-bedroom, 4.5-bath home, perfectly located on a quiet cul-de-sac just steps from Winslow Park, The Westport Country Playhouse, and downtown.    This spacious home sleeps 10 comfortably and is finished on three levels, offering plenty of room for family and guests. The main level features elegant living spaces filled with natural light, while the lower level includes a casual hangout area, a second kitchen, a bedroom, and a full bath - ideal for entertaining or providing extra privacy for guests.    Outside, enjoy a beautiful back deck and a lush yard perfect for summer barbecues or relaxing with a book. Bike to Compo Beach, stroll into town for evening dinners, or spend the day at nearby Longshore - all just minutes away, including the train for easy NYC access.      Rental dates are flexible during the summer months. This is your perfect summer escape in Westport - luxurious, private and convenient!
